prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Miltank (밀탱크) personified, normal type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo — never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: heavy drooping eyelids, unfocused gaze, softened slack mouth, brow low and relaxed
Pose: Rest a hand or forearm on a table, counter or railing in a relaxed supported pose.
Orientation: reclined body supported by a surface
Scene: A quiet conservatory lounge at blue hour, beside a pale upholstered chaise and softly glowing frosted glass lamps.
Outfit and props: Opaque cream satin with blush-pink edge piping, a small black geometric embroidery at the neckline and a tiny bell-shaped pendant; no robe or extra layer.
Category: Use tasteful adult lingerie-inspired evening fashion with full intimate coverage. Describe the garment by its construction — cut, fabric, trim, straps, closures, layers — rather than by mood words. The garments are securely fitted and fully opaque, and the look is suitable for a mainstream evening-fashion editorial. Build the image through framing, silhouette, posture, and lighting rather than exposure.
Example scene: a bias-cut satin lingerie slip with narrow straps and a straight hem
Framing: Three-quarter portrait framing from the head to just above the knees, with the scene's hand action readable.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
source_influence: balanced — a few source color and marking cues integrated into everyday clothing
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers of natural length, clearly separated, never merged, doubled or extra.
